subject.title: feat(ios): show OpenClaw logo in notch

question: Should OpenClaw ship screenshot-only notch branding in the iOS app using TopNotch's private UIScreen notch geometry lookup and a new forked Swift package dependency?
rationale: This optional visual feature has App Store, provenance, and licensing tradeoffs that cannot be resolved from code correctness alone.

options.title: Approve after dependency and archive validation
options.body: Verify TopNotch licensing/provenance, add required iOS license resources, run the current merge-result iOS archive with the normal Watch target enabled, and record iOS/release-owner approval for the private API.

options.title: Use public-API branding
options.body: Replace the notch overlay with branding that avoids private UIKit introspection if App Store review risk is not acceptable.

options.title: Defer the overlay
options.body: Pause or close the PR if screenshot-only notch branding is not worth the release-policy and dependency cost.

recommendation.title: Approve after dependency and archive validation
recommendation.body: Verify TopNotch licensing/provenance, add required iOS license resources, run the current merge-result iOS archive with the normal Watch target enabled, and record iOS/release-owner approval for the private API.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant most directly owns the current iOS license/release guardrails that this PR must satisfy before release-owner approval.
